summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the Multi-Domain AI Butler Collaboration Platform (多場域 AI 管家協作平台) login page. All core UI elements display correctly with proper Lakeze Prestige styling, authentication flows work as expected, and mobile responsiveness is implemented properly.

integration_issues.issue: CORS policy blocking requests to external API from localhost development environment
integration_issues.note: Expected behavior in development environment - external API requires CORS configuration for localhost access

design_issues.issue: WebSocket trying to connect to localhost:443 instead of external WebSocket URL
design_issues.note: Should use REACT_APP_WS_URL from environment variables

passed_tests: Login page UI displays correctly with all required elements
Lakeze logo loads properly on both desktop and mobile
Brand title '多場域 AI 管家協作平台' displays correctly
Email and password input fields work with proper validation
Login button functions with loading states
Lakeze Prestige deep olive green design theme (#3D4A2C) implemented
HTML5 form validation works for required fields
Error handling displays appropriate messages after failed login
Authentication flow correctly remains on login page after failed attempt
Protected routes correctly redirect unauthenticated users to login page
Dashboard and Settings pages properly protected with authentication guards
Mobile responsiveness works - mobile logo displays and desktop brand panel hidden
Form elements accessible and functional on mobile devices
